title: click: Bug report (issue #3458) from a user of this library, a regression in the latest re
prompt:
This repo is click (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #3458) from a user of this library, a regression in the latest release:

> Inside a custom `ParamType.convert()`, `ctx.get_parameter_source(param.name)` now returns `None`. It used to return the source (`DEFAULT`, `COMMANDLINE`, ...). The same goes for eager option callbacks. Minimal example:
>
> ```python
> class Source(click.ParamType):
>     name = "source"
>     def convert(self, value, param, ctx):
>         return (value, ctx.get_parameter_source(param.name))
>
> @click.command()
> @click.option("--default", type=Source(), default="/tmp/file")
> def cli(default):
>     click.echo(default)
> ```
>
> prints `('/tmp/file', None)` instead of `('/tmp/file', <ParameterSource.DEFAULT: 3>)`. When several options share one parameter name, the source reported afterwards must still be the one of the option that won.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
